## source_to_kb

**Variants and base policies.** Re-checked for this task's subjects (rollover_and_extension, draw_conversion, draw_order, activation, ordering, billing): every variant cell and every base clause has its home as listed in policy_kb/prepaid_service_hours/0.md (same corpus, same result; re-verified here for the 160-Hour column: extension months 6, fee 7.5, max 1, rate 135.00, list 21600.00, discount 5 / rank 3, signature activation, due 30, technician 1.0 / senior 1.25 / architect 1.5, after-hours 1.25, emergency and holiday 1.75, increment 15, remote minimum 15, onsite minimum 60, trip hours 0.0, project eligible yes, low balance 10).

**Retired surface.** (a) extension_quote overwrite of the base fee clause -> rollover_and_extension_terms item 8: "This clause is no longer in force: ... The fee of an extension, every extension being bought on the authorized contact's signed order form, is now figured under the current extension fee basis and invoiced when the extension takes effect on that signature. A block whose hours were rolled out still cannot be extended." — replaced_by carried, and the non-retired rollout bar restated as in force. (b) remote / installation / project-group overwrites of minutes, conversion and band -> draw_eligibility_and_conversion_rules B.1-B.3, each retired for exactly "a remote session, a service visit, an installation visit, or a group of time-and-materials project time of a client holding exactly one live time-and-materials engagement"; the out-of-scope project time "keeps this clause, wholly and line by line" (B.1) and keeps B.2/B.3 — the replaced_by in-force restatements are carried. Nothing retired beyond the source.

**timebank_ext_extension_quote.** Signed-form purchase, fee rounded half up, invoiced on the signature, rolled-out bar -> block_extension_order_form para 1. Baseline (fee pct of hours balance at the size's rate, rounded) -> extension_fee_amount (balance "on the day the extension is signed", rounding once on the fee, figures "of the block's size in the TimeBank terms"). Assembly order (replacements of percentage and hour value, then points, then multipliers, rounding once) -> carried by each schedule's own statement against the baseline quantities ("the fee percentage ... depends on how early it is signed"; "Points are added to the extension fee percentage"; "the value of each remaining hour"; "the fee multiplied by") with extension_fee_amount's single final rounding; the standing document's hypothetical "A 6 percent fee percentage with 1 point becomes 7 percent" fixes points-after-replacement. Factors, every tier:
- signing_lead_rate: >= 60 days -> 5; 30-59 -> 6; else size pct; signing date not counted -> extension_early_signing_percentage. Exact.
- payment_standing_points: late fee in 12 months -> +2; else paid in full, or unpaid/partly paid, more than due days after posting -> +1; else 0; own-invoice payments -> extension_payment_standing_points (due days per size stated in figures). Exact.
- hour_valuation_basis: rolled-in -> price / (purchased + rolled in), cent; invoiced < list -> price / purchased, cent; else size rate -> extension_hour_valuation. Exact.
- clearpath_loyalty_rate: Premier/Enterprise renewed >= 1 -> 0.5; Professional/Standard renewed >= 1 -> 0.75; else 1 -> extension_clearpath_loyalty_multiplier. Exact.
- recent_use_rate: >= 0.25 -> 0.8; >= 0.10 < 0.25 -> 0.9; else 1; draws dated after the same day three months earlier -> extension_recent_use_multiplier. Exact.
- engagement_commitment_rate: T&M in progress + block-routed time in the month -> 0.9; T&M in progress, none -> 0.95; else 1 -> extension_project_commitment_multiplier. Exact.

**timebank_ext_remote_session_draw.** Scope, drawn once at resolution, own-records-only, selection with tie-breaks, no-figure conditions -> remote_support_session_draws + remote_session_block_hours. Band rule -> hub "Band recorded". Baseline -> remote_session_block_hours "Block hours". Assembly order (floors, weighting, multipliers/ratio) -> "The minutes drawn are settled first"; weighting acts on "the minutes drawn"; tool `worked_minutes` "after rounding and any floor". Factors: remote_floor_minutes (after-hours + phone 60 / how-to no floor / else size minimum) -> remote_session_minimum_minutes; remote_callout_basis (weekday after-hours P1 phone split / weekend raise to 120 / else as the floors leave them) -> remote_session_callout_and_weekend_minutes; remote_band_rate -> remote_session_band_multiplier; remote_level_ratio (security concern architect / outage senior / else technician, level recorded) -> remote_session_handling_level; remote_clearpath_rate (Professional 0.9 / Standard-Essentials-Monitor 0.95 / else 1; Premier and Enterprise never in the after-hours class — a source sentence) -> remote_session_clearpath_after_hours_rate. All tiers exact.

**timebank_ext_install_visit_draw.** Scope, drawn once, own ticket and order alone, selection with tie-breaks, installation test with its order tie-breaks (more units, higher quote number), service-visit fallback, no-figure conditions -> onsite_installation_visit_draws + installation_visit_block_hours. Band rule (never emergency) -> hub "Band recorded". Baseline -> installation_visit_block_hours "Block hours". Factors: install_unit_minutes (staged 20/unit whatever the minutes; standard max(rounded, 45/unit); other rounded) -> installation_minutes_per_endpoint_unit; install_band_rate + band recorded -> installation_visit_band_multiplier; install_lead_ratio (>= 25 architect, 10-24 senior, else technician) -> installation_rollout_lead_level; install_clearpath_rate (endpoint orders: Premier/Enterprise 0.8, Professional/Standard 0.9, else 1) -> installation_clearpath_endpoint_rate; install_rush_rate (day 0 1.25, day 1-2 1.15, else 1) -> installation_rush_order_rate. All tiers exact.

**timebank_ext_project_time_draw.** Scope (exactly one T&M engagement signed/in progress/on hold/pending acceptance; decided by engagement records alone), out-of-scope project time keeping the standard rules line by line, band recorded (never emergency), worked minutes after floor/whole-hour rounding -> project_time_group_draws. Logging-at-close, group order architect -> senior -> technician, drawn-ness test, no-figure conditions, baseline (summed minutes / 60, technician, 1, rounded once) -> project_group_block_hours. Assembly (minute replacements, then multipliers/ratio, a partial multiplier leaving the rest at 1) -> project_time_band_multiplier "the rest of the group's minutes drawn, if any, keep a multiplier of 1". Factors: project_minutes_basis (weekend >= 240; weekday after-hours rounded up to 60s plus business minutes; else summed) -> project_cutover_and_maintenance_window_minutes; project_band_rate (weekend holiday multiplier on summed >= 240; weekday after-hours minutes rounded to 60s at after-hours multiplier) -> project_time_band_multiplier (the source's band schedule defines its band minutes itself; the KB repeats it as the source does); project_level_ratio -> project_time_level_ratio; project_discount_band (>= 10 -> 0.9, > 0 < 10 -> 0.95, 0 -> 1) -> project_locked_rate_discount_multiplier; project_class_rate (Major/Strategic 0.9, Standard/Advanced 0.95, else 1) -> project_engagement_class_program_rate. All tiers exact.
